title: Psalm 97: The LORD Reigns in Cloud and Fire
summary: The psalm announces that the LORD reigns and describes his appearing in the images of storm and volcano: cloud and darkness, fire, lightning, and mountains melting like wax. Idol worshipers are put to shame, while Zion rejoices at his judgments. The psalm closes by calling those who love the LORD to hate evil, trust his protection, and rejoice in him.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 47
from.text: It is one of the enthronement psalms, a group (usually 47, 93, and 95 to 99) that celebrate the LORD as king.

line: The LORD reigns, appearing in cloud and fire; idols are put to shame, and those who love him are called to hate evil and rejoice.
guide: Hold awe and joy together: God is fearsome, and he is the reason the righteous rejoice. Carry verse 11 into a dark week; the light it promises may start small, like seed, and grow.

care.text: Why does a psalm of joy tell people to hate (verse 10)? Look at what it says to hate: evil, not people. To love what is good means to reject what harms it. Being careless about evil would be a failure of love. And the psalm does not make God's people into judges or avengers. It says God guards and rescues. Hatred of evil here is never permission to harm anyone.

stanzas.title: The LORD appears in cloud, fire, and lightning
Idolaters ashamed, Zion glad, the LORD Most High
Those who love the LORD: hate evil and rejoice

verses.t: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
